Member hospitals with bed counts, new security roles and job listings.
Hospital staff registered for healthcare security sessions this season.

system.signal: A public post about a phishing scare, a new security hire at a hospital, or a name on the attendee list for a human-layer risk session.

chain.title: Collect
chain.body: Pulls new posts, directory changes and attendee names every morning.

chain.title: Match
chain.body: Scores each hospital by bed count, role and how recent the signal is.

chain.title: Find the person
chain.body: Finds the IT director and verifies the email before anything is drafted.

chain.title: Draft
chain.body: Writes one line about the exact post, role or session, then the offer.

chain.title: Your approval
chain.body: Every draft waits for a person. Nothing sends on its own.

chain.title: Replies
chain.body: Tags each reply and feeds the outcome back into the scoring.

system.approval: A person approves every draft before it sends.

stack.name: Hermes agents
stack.role: Runs collection, matching and drafting as separate agents

stack.name: X API
stack.role: Watches IT director posts about phishing and training

stack.name: Directory scrape
stack.role: Reads the state hospital member list and jobs board
